meta.title: TinyMotion: activity recognition that runs on your phone
meta.description: Your phone's motion sensors recognise walking, stairs, sitting, standing and lying in real time, on the device. Download the same tiny models for microcontrollers. Built on peer-reviewed research.
meta.tagline: AI that knows how you move.

common.offlineBody: Pages you've opened before still work, and live recognition runs fully offline once the page has loaded.
common.errorBody: The page hit an error. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell us at {email}.

account.title: Your account
